server.name: io.github.Gemberkoekje/easel
server.description: A headless painting engine for AI agents: brushes, paint load, wet blending, canvas texture.
server.title: Easel

runtimeArguments.description: The whole launch command is: uvx --from "easel-paint[mcp]" easel-mcp. Two things make it longer than usual. The MCP server is an optional extra, because nothing else in the engine imports mcp and a painter working from Python or the shell never needs its 28 dependencies; and the console script is easel-mcp, not easel-paint, because the package is a painting engine of which the server is one face. A client that cannot assemble this should run that command verbatim.
runtimeArguments.name: --from

packageArguments.description: Directory the server reads and writes .easel session files, looks and exported PNGs in. Defaults to the working directory.
packageArguments.name: --dir
